_comment: How long food keeps, by ingredient and where it is kept. Every number here is an ESTIMATE from a table, never a date anybody gave, and the fold keeps that distinction all the way to what Alexa+ says. See docs/SHELF_LIFE_SCHEMA.md.
author: the author's kitchen
